diagnosis: The custom action directly retrieves the Project using Project.objects.get(pk=pk) instead of calling self.get_object(). This bypasses DRF's object-level permission checks configured in permission_classes, allowing any authenticated user to archive projects they do not belong to.

Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
